snippet.title: DEAD ESTATE - THE 'GOOD NIGHT' UPDATE TRAILER
snippet.description:
𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐍𝐈𝐆𝐇𝐓𝐌𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐌𝐀𝐘 𝐁𝐄 𝐄𝐍𝐃𝐈𝐍𝐆, 𝐁𝐔𝐓 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐃𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐌 𝐇𝐀𝐒 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐁𝐄𝐆𝐔𝐍.

THE FINAL MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE FOR DEAD ESTATE, "GOOD NIGHT", IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM & ITCH.IO!
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1484720/Dead_Estate/
ITCH: https://milkbar-lads.itch.io/dead-estate
 
4 NEW full-sized floors, over 30 NEW weapons, 70 NEW items, 10 NEW Challenges, NEW costumes and A FINAL ENDING to unlock the truth underneath the mansion... and inside the dream...

Brought to you by the @MilkbarLads & @2leftthumbs !
